title: list carries both stores: live and history
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/conversations' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert {'live','history'} <= set(d); assert {'count','profiles','providers','items'} <= set(d['live']); assert d['history']['available'] is True"

title: history reports a real total
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/conversations' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); h=d['history']; assert h['total']>0; assert len(h['conversations'])<=int(h['filter']['per'])"

title: default order is newest activity first
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/conversations?per=20' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); ls=[c['last_at'] or '' for c in d['history']['conversations']]; assert ls==sorted(ls, reverse=True), ls[:4]"

title: page count matches the total
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/conversations?per=20' | python3 -c "import sys,json,math; d=json.load(sys.stdin); f=d['history']['filter']; assert f['pages']==max(1,math.ceil(f['total']/20)), (f['pages'],f['total'])"

title: consecutive pages do not overlap
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/conversations?per=5&page=1' > /tmp/cv1.json; curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/conversations?per=5&page=2' > /tmp/cv2.json; python3 -c "import json; a=[c['id'] for c in json.load(open('/tmp/cv1.json'))['history']['conversations']]; b=[c['id'] for c in json.load(open('/tmp/cv2.json'))['history']['conversations']]; assert not (set(a)&set(b)), set(a)&set(b)"

title: sort=oldest reverses the order
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/conversations?per=10&sort=oldest' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); h=d['history']; ls=[c['last_at'] or '' for c in h['conversations']]; assert ls==sorted(ls), ls[:4]; assert h['filter']['sort']=='oldest'"

title: sort=messages is monotonic descending
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/conversations?per=100&sort=messages' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); m=[c['messages'] for c in d['history']['conversations']]; known=[x for x in m if x is not None]; assert known==sorted(known, reverse=True), known[:6]; assert all(x is None for x in m[len(known):]), m[:12]"

title: sort=calls is monotonic descending
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/conversations?per=100&sort=calls' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); c=[x['tool_calls'] for x in d['history']['conversations']]; known=[x for x in c if x is not None]; assert known==sorted(known, reverse=True), known[:6]; assert all(x is None for x in c[len(known):]), c[:12]"

title: the four sorts are advertised to the client
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/conversations' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); keys=[s['key'] for s in d['history']['filter']['sorts']]; assert keys==['newest','oldest','messages','calls'], keys"

title: profile filter narrows and echoes back
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/conversations' > /tmp/cva.json; curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/conversations?profile=l2' > /tmp/cvb.json; python3 -c "import json; a=json.load(open('/tmp/cva.json'))['history']; b=json.load(open('/tmp/cvb.json'))['history']; assert b['total']<a['total'], (b['total'],a['total']); assert b['filter']['profile']=='l2'; assert all(c['profile']=='l2' for c in b['conversations'])"

title: search by id narrows to one conversation
cmd: cid=$(curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/conversations?per=1' | python3 -c 'import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["history"]["conversations"][0]["id"])'); curl -s "{{BASE}}/api/conversations?q=$cid" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); h=d['history']; assert h['total']==1, h['total']; assert h['conversations'][0]['id']=='$cid'"

title: an impossible search returns zero, not an error
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/conversations?q=zzzz-no-such-conversation-zzzz' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); h=d['history']; assert h['total']==0; assert h['conversations']==[]"

title: page past the end clamps instead of 500ing
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/conversations?per=5&page=99999' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); f=d['history']['filter']; assert f['page']==f['pages'], f"

title: the list is idempotent
cmd: a=$(curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/conversations?per=5' | md5sum); b=$(curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/conversations?per=5' | md5sum); [ "$a" = "$b" ]

title: transcript without cid is 400 JSON
cmd: [ "$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '{{HTTP}}' '{{BASE}}/api/conversations/messages')" = "400" ] && curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/conversations/messages' | python3 -c "import sys,json; assert 'error' in json.load(sys.stdin)"

title: transcript reports its own window honestly
cmd: cid=$(curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/conversations?per=1' | python3 -c 'import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["history"]["conversations"][0]["id"])'); curl -s "{{BASE}}/api/conversations/messages?cid=$cid" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert {'id','messages','truncated','total','newest'} <= set(d); assert d['id']=='$cid'; assert d['truncated'] == (d['total'] > len(d['messages'])), (d['truncated'], d['total'], len(d['messages']))"

title: transcript messages are in stored (seq) order
cmd: cid=$(curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/conversations?per=1' | python3 -c 'import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["history"]["conversations"][0]["id"])'); curl -s "{{BASE}}/api/conversations/messages?cid=$cid" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); sq=[m['seq'] for m in d['messages']]; assert sq==sorted(sq), 'transcript is not in append order'; assert len(set(sq))==len(sq), 'duplicate seq'"

title: an unknown cid returns an empty transcript, not a 500
cmd: c=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '{{HTTP}}' '{{BASE}}/api/conversations/messages?cid=nope'); [ "$c" = "200" ] && curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/conversations/messages?cid=nope' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert d['messages']==[]; assert d['total']==0"

title: a traversal-shaped cid does not read the filesystem
cmd: c=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '{{HTTP}}' '{{BASE}}/api/conversations/messages?cid=../../etc/passwd'); [ "$c" != "500" ] && curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/conversations/messages?cid=../../etc/passwd' | grep -qv 'root:x:'

title: audit without cid is 400 JSON
cmd: [ "$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '{{HTTP}}' '{{BASE}}/api/conversations/audit')" = "400" ] && curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/conversations/audit' | python3 -c "import sys,json; assert 'error' in json.load(sys.stdin)"

title: audit reports availability and the rollup
cmd: cid=$(curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/conversations?per=1' | python3 -c 'import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["history"]["conversations"][0]["id"])'); curl -s "{{BASE}}/api/conversations/audit?cid=$cid" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert d.get('available') is True; assert d['id']=='$cid'; assert 'tools' in d and 'first_ask' in d"

title: audit message count equals the transcript total
cmd: cid=$(curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/conversations?per=1' | python3 -c 'import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["history"]["conversations"][0]["id"])'); curl -s "{{BASE}}/api/conversations/messages?cid=$cid" > /tmp/cvm.json; curl -s "{{BASE}}/api/conversations/audit?cid=$cid" > /tmp/cva2.json; python3 -c "import json; m=json.load(open('/tmp/cvm.json')); a=json.load(open('/tmp/cva2.json')); assert a['messages']==m['total'], (a['messages'], m['total'])"

title: audit tool counts sum to the reported tool_calls
cmd: cid=$(curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/conversations?per=1' | python3 -c 'import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["history"]["conversations"][0]["id"])'); curl -s "{{BASE}}/api/conversations/audit?cid=$cid" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); s=sum(t['count'] for t in d.get('tools') or []); assert s==(d.get('tool_calls') or 0), (s, d.get('tool_calls'))"

title: an unknown cid reports unavailable, not a 500
cmd: c=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '{{HTTP}}' '{{BASE}}/api/conversations/audit?cid=nope'); [ "$c" = "200" ] && curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/conversations/audit?cid=nope' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert d.get('available') is False"

title: the page renders live + history with a caption
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/conversations' | python3 -c "import sys,re; h=sys.stdin.read(); assert 'In flight' in h; assert 'History' in h; assert len(re.findall(r'<caption', h))>=2, 'a table is uncaptioned'"

title: every conversation header carries scope=col
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/conversations' | python3 -c "import sys,re; h=sys.stdin.read(); ths=re.findall(r'<th[\s>](?![^>]*scope)', h); assert not ths, len(ths)"
